articles.title: OKX and NYSE partner to bridge tradfi and crypto markets in joint venture led by Andrew Cuomo
articles.snippet: The goal is to enable OKX’s 120 million global users to access ICE futures and NYSE tokenized equities markets, the two U.S. companies announced.

articles.title: Strategy added $35 million in bitcoin, $300 million in cash reserves last week
articles.snippet: The boost to cash reserves is meant to reassure investors about dividend payments on the company's hard-hit preferred shares, STRC.

articles.title: Taiko urges users to withdraw as bridge exploit drains $1.7M
articles.snippet: Taiko’s bridge and ERC20 Vault on Ethereum suffered a compromise in its chain state verification mechanism, allowing forged proofs and unauthorized withdrawals.

articles.title: Dash eyes Philippines as market for crypto payments
articles.snippet: Dash is assessing the Philippines for a crypto payments push as regulators promote easier business registration, though industry participants say compliant market entry can still take years.

articles.title: Trump Orders Acceleration of Quantum Readiness as Bitcoin Faces Coming Risk
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump signed two executive orders aimed at expanding U.S. quantum computing capabilities and speeding the transition to quantum-resistant encryption.
